articles.summary: During Sri Rama Navami celebrations, a temple priest allegedly ordered women from the Goud toddy-tapper community to leave a local Ramalayam in Tallarampur village. Kairi Kalyani and her neighbors had arrived with offerings to perform rituals but faced humiliation and exclusion based on their community background. The incident highlights ongoing discrimination and the difficult fight for social rights in rural areas.
articles.description: For over two years, 45 toddy-tapper and 10 Dalit families in Nizamabad’s Tallarampur have allegedly faced a complete social boycott for defying their Village Development Committee’s (VDC) orders. Denied access to groceries, medical aid and social gatherings, they have been pushed to the margins of everyday life. The growing clout of VDCs and nearly 90 complaints of alleged excesses before the Backward Classes Commission bring the larger issue into focus, as Ravi Reddy finds during a ground visit

articles.headline: Donald Trump designates Oval Office as a national monument
articles.title: Trump designates Oval Office as national monument
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump signed an executive order on November 5, 2026, officially designating the Oval Office and Cabinet Room as national monuments to prevent future structural alterations. The announcement followed a difficult midterm election outcome for his Republican Party and drew criticism from opponents who argued the administration was ignoring pressing national concerns in favor of ongoing White House renovations.
articles.description: Critics accused Donald Trump of ignoring voter concerns over the Iran war and affordability ahead of midterm elections and obsessing instead on multiple construction and renovation projects in the capital

articles.headline: Keralam faces new challenges amid rising elderly population
articles.title: Solitary autumn years: Keralam to face new challenges with rise in elderly population
articles.summary: A domestic worker in Thiruvananthapuram named Sadia frequently travels to Tamil Nadu to care for her ailing elderly mother, spending half her salary on medical expenses while struggling with family property issues. This personal situation reflects broader socioeconomic challenges in Keralam regarding an increasing aging demographic. Published on November 6, 2026, the report highlights the growing strain on family support systems, unemployed siblings, and medical costs for elderly residents without adequate safety nets.
articles.description: Keralam’s elderly population is poised to go up significantly in a decade, which in turn, would bring up new challenges for the State in the elderly care. R.K. Roshni meets some of the elders and experts to understand the ground situation

articles.headline: White House denies departure rumours for Pete Hegseth and Marco Rubio
articles.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
articles.summary: The White House and the US State Department have rejected reports that Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio are leaving their posts following Republican midterm election losses. President Donald Trump expressed support for Hegseth despite criticism over the Iran war, while Rubio confirmed he plans to finish his term.
articles.description: US media reports there are calls to replace Pete Hegseth, who also faces a possible impeachment vote, while Marco Rubio is rumoured to be eyeing a presidential run.

articles.headline: Bhupender Yadav accuses Congress of spreading anarchy over electoral rolls
articles.title: Congress wants to spread anarchy in the name of democracy: Bhupender Yadav
articles.summary: Union Minister Bhupender Yadav criticized the Congress party and other opposition groups on November 5, 2026, for creating confusion regarding the special intensive revision of electoral rolls. Speaking in Patna, the Bharatiya Janata Party leader stated that the revision is a routine constitutional process managed by the Election Commission of India under Article 324.
articles.description: He added that instead of creating confusion over the special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, the opposition should present facts to the public

articles.headline: Gaza turns discarded cooking pots into seawalls
articles.title: Gaza turns discarded cooking pots into seawalls
articles.description: As winter approaches, Palestinians in Gaza are turning damaged cooking pots into makeshift seawalls to avoid flooding.

articles.headline: Truck collision on Karra-Torpa road kills seven people in Jharkhand
articles.title: Seven including three children killed after run over by truck in Khunti
articles.summary: Seven people, including three children and three women, were killed and one person was injured after being struck by an 18-wheel truck in the Khunti district of Jharkhand. Khunti Superintendent of Police Rishabh Garg stated that the incident occurred on November 5, 2026, on the Karra-Torpa main road within the Karra police station jurisdiction.
articles.description: The incident happened on the Karra-Torpa main road within the Karra police station limits on November 5, 2026 night

articles.headline: Harmeet Kaur Dhillon resigns as United States Assistant Attorney General
articles.title: U.S. Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon resigns
articles.summary: Indian-American official Harmeet Kaur Dhillon stepped down from her role leading the Department of Justice Civil Rights Division following the mid-term elections. Attorney General Todd Blanche confirmed the departure on Thursday on social media. Dhillon stated she delayed her public announcement per White House chief of staff Susie Wiles to ensure the news followed the conclusion of voting.
articles.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche announced her resignation in a social media post, saying Assistant Attorney General Dhillon had "led the Civil Rights Division with conviction

articles.headline: West Bengal government discusses Ashok Leyland plant for Singur site
articles.title: Will do something for Singur, West Bengal CM signals fresh industrial push
articles.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced on November 5, 2026, that his administration is in discussions with Ashok Leyland to establish a vehicle manufacturing plant in Singur. Speaking during the unveiling of the state investment promotion policy, Adhikari outlined plans to purchase land directly through state funds without utilizing police force for acquisitions.
articles.description: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the government was in talks with Ashok Leyland for setting up a plant at Singur

articles.headline: Union Minister J.P. Nadda sets March 2027 completion deadline for AIIMS Awantipora
articles.title: J&K’s health sector receives a shot in arm as Union Minister J.P. Nadda sets AIIMS deadline for March
articles.summary: Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda announced on November 5, 2026, that the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in Awantipora will be completed by March 2027. During a project review, Nadda directed officials to prioritize essential equipment procurement to facilitate outpatient department services and prepare for the commencement of MBBS classes in 2027.
articles.description: During a review of the phase-wise construction and handover plan, the Union Minister was informed that Phase-I buildings, including the OPD Registration Block, OPD Block, residential buildings and designated hostels, had been completed

articles.headline: Violence disrupts third phase of Rajasthan panchayat elections
articles.title: Violence mars third phase of Rajasthan panchayat elections
articles.summary: Clashes, stone-pelting, and allegations of bogus voting marred the third phase of panchayat elections across twenty-seven districts of Rajasthan on Thursday. Supporters of rival candidates fought in multiple districts, resulting in one death and several injuries in Jhunjhunu district. Police detained suspects and utilized a lathi charge to control crowds, while voting was cancelled at one village panchayat due to a missing candidate.

articles.headline: Kanchan Katkar crafts silver ornaments in Hupari for decades
articles.title: The silver hands of Hupari
articles.summary: Residing within the twisting lanes of Hupari town, seventy-six-year-old Kanchan Katkar meticulously attaches silver ghungroos to chain loops using iron tongs. Having completed school in 1970, she chose to remain single following the marriage of her sisters in order to care for her parents, who had actively participated in the Indian freedom struggle.
articles.description: In Maharashtra’s Hupari town, women artisans drive a ₹1,000-crore silver industry, sustaining a century-old trade. Radheshyam Jadhav reports on how, despite being underpaid and excluded from formal leadership, they forge their own economic autonomy in a deeply traditional landscape

articles.headline: OpenAI drops non-disclosure agreements for upcoming data center community projects
articles.title: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
articles.summary: Following recent midterms where voters opposed data center expansions, OpenAI announced it will no longer use non-disclosure agreements with public officials for future projects. The ChatGPT maker promised to cover full electricity and infrastructure costs, publish job creation data, and establish local compacts reflecting community priorities in regions where it operates compute campuses.
articles.description: Following this week's midterms where voters resoundingly voiced their opposition to data center expansion, OpenAI today announced new commitments to communities where it is working on data center projects, including that it won't use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public officials. Many data center projects have come under scrutiny for relying on NDAs to hide discussions […]

articles.headline: Israeli settlers set fire to Palestinian olive grove near Ramallah
articles.title: Israeli settlers set fire to Palestinian olive grove near Ramallah
articles.description: Israeli settlers have set fire to olive trees belonging to Palestinian farmers in the village of Burqa, near Ramallah.

articles.headline: Airbnb develops artificial intelligence travel agent for 2027 release
articles.title: Airbnb is working on an AI travel agent
articles.summary: Airbnb plans to launch an artificial intelligence agent in the first half of 2027 to assist users with trip planning and bookings, according to its third-quarter shareholder letter. Chief Executive Officer Brian Chesky stated that the custom-designed interface will dynamically compose elements like maps and itineraries rather than operating as a traditional chatbot.
articles.description: Airbnb plans to roll out an AI agent in the first half of 2027 that will help users plan and book travel, the company said in its Q3 2026 earnings shareholder letter released today. "Today's AI agents are good at simple, routine tasks, like making a restaurant reservation or scheduling an appointment," Airbnb said. "But […]

articles.headline: Pope Leo XIV begins Latin American tour following lung cancer surgery
articles.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV is embarking on a twelve-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru just three weeks after undergoing surgery to remove a lung tumor. The Vatican stated that no extraordinary health measures are required for the seventy-one-year-old pontiff, whose itinerary features a homecoming to Peru where he previously served as a priest.
articles.description: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.

articles.headline: Kashmir faces ongoing terror threats despite drop in local militants
articles.title: Just one local terrorist active in Kashmir, but terror threat remains: IGP Sujit Kumar
articles.summary: Inspector General of Police Sujit Kumar reported that militancy in Kashmir has dropped to one active local terrorist, identified as Lateef Ahmad, alongside transitioning foreign operatives. Speaking on November 5, 2026, the official noted that security forces remain on alert while addressing additional regional challenges involving drug abuse, cybercrime, and traffic violations.
articles.description: The police identified Lateef Ahmad, 21, a resident of south Kashmir’s Kulgam, as the terrorist behind the Anantnag attack, which left one policeman dead in Anantnag’s Lal Chowk

articles.headline: Delhi implements winter action plan to combat seasonal air pollution
articles.title: Delhi's toxic winter air is back - is the Indian capital prepared for pollution?
articles.summary: The Delhi government has launched a Winter Action Plan to address the city's annual spike in toxic air pollution. The measures include construction bans and vehicle restrictions effective through February. While experts welcome the early planning, they warn that long-term success depends on stricter enforcement and regional cooperation to address diverse sources of harmful emissions.
articles.description: The Delhi government has announced a four-month winter action plan, but experts say that won't be enough.

articles.headline: Perplexity launches new work-focused AI agents
articles.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence startup Perplexity has introduced always-on workspace agents called Teammates to compete with offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic. Operating continuously, these agents integrate with Perplexity Computer to handle concurrent large-scale tasks. The feature is available exclusively through the platform's two hundred dollars per month Max subscription plan, allowing users to monitor progress via dedicated application threads and Slack integrations.
articles.description: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use. Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, an AI system that can deploy agents on your device […]

articles.headline: Generation Z voters help redefine United States politics
articles.title: Generation Z and young voters help redefine US politics after midterms
articles.summary: The United States midterm elections marked a significant political shift as younger citizens voted overwhelmingly for the Democratic Party. Melat Kiros secured a historic victory in Colorado, becoming the first Generation Z woman elected to Congress. While voters under thirty represented a relatively small share of the total electorate, national polling indicated their strong dissatisfaction with current leadership and opposition to Donald Trump.
articles.description: Melat Kiros becomes the first Generation Z woman elected to Congress, embodying a new era of political representation.

articles.headline: South Africa ruling party faces sharp vote decline
articles.title: South Africa’s ANC on track for new lows in local polls
articles.summary: Early municipal election results in South Africa showed a sharply reduced vote share for the African National Congress, weakening the dominant party's control over major metropolitan areas like Johannesburg. Election commission data released on Thursday indicated voter turnout reached approximately fifty-four percent. Final outcomes, expected by Sunday, could trigger complex coalition negotiations across multiple city councils following widespread public frustration over municipal mismanagement.
articles.description: The ANC was on about 32 percent of the vote with more than 60 percent of votes counted in municipal elections.

articles.headline: West Bengal government announces investment policy promoting job-linked growth
articles.title: West Bengal govt’s new investment policy promotes job-linked growth, incentives for plant and machinery
articles.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party government in West Bengal unveiled a new investment promotion policy on November 5, 2026, offering incentives for plant and machinery investments and prioritising job creation. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari stated the policy provides up to one hundred twenty percent assistance for thrust sectors and includes employer provident fund contribution reimbursements for women and transgender employees.
articles.description: The announcement of incentives marks a policy shift for West Bengal as the previous Trinamool Congress government had scrapped industrial incentive schemes and subsidies

articles.headline: Israeli demolitions displace more than 100 Palestinians in Biddu
articles.title: Israeli demolitions displace more than 100 Palestinians in Biddu
articles.description: Israeli forces demolished five homes in Biddu, occupied West Bank, displacing more than 100 people.

articles.headline: United Nations report warns climate adaptation funding is insufficient
articles.title: Why are wealthy countries failing developing nations?
articles.summary: The United Nations Environment Programme released a report warning that global climate adaptation funding is falling far short of necessary requirements. The organization criticized wealthy nations for failing to fulfill financial pledges made at successive Conference of the Parties meetings to help developing countries build resilience against growing environmental costs and escalating economic crises linked directly to global carbon emissions.
articles.description: UN report warns climate adaptation funding is falling far short of needs.

articles.headline: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri discusses Nepal Prime Minister's upcoming India visit
articles.title: Foreign Secretary Misri sets stage for Nepal PM’s upcoming India visit
articles.summary: Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri met with Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah in Kathmandu on November 5, 2026, to prepare for the leader's upcoming visit to New Delhi. Discussions covered bilateral cooperation in hydropower, connectivity, and digital infrastructure. Both nations expressed gratitude for India's recent humanitarian assistance following the severe Bhotekoshi floods earlier this year.
articles.description: The Nepali leaders expressed “gratitude for India’s swift and substantial humanitarian and technical assistance in the aftermath of the Bhotekoshi floods”, a joint press release stated

articles.headline: European air travel disrupted by coordinated series of false bomb threats
articles.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
articles.summary: Coordinated hoax bomb threats targeted multiple European airlines and airports, prompting flight diversions and fighter jet escorts in Italy. While analysts suspect possible hybrid warfare involvement by Russia amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, authorities stated that no definitive evidence has linked Moscow or any proxy groups to the incidents as of Thursday evening.
articles.description: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.

articles.headline: Enforcement Directorate searches premises linked to housing society founder
articles.title: ED searches 12 premises linked to BLM society
articles.summary: The Enforcement Directorate conducted search operations on twelve premises linked to the Bharath Lajhna Multi State Housing Co-operative Society Limited and founder R. Premkumar across Kerala and Chennai on Wednesday. According to authorities, the investigation targets the alleged laundering of public funds amounting to approximately eighty crore rupees through numerous bank accounts controlled by the founder and his relatives.
articles.description: The searches were related to the alleged misappropriation and laundering of public funds belonging to Bharath Lajhna Multi State Housing Co-operative Society Ltd. by its founder

articles.headline: Nigerian court invalidates opposition presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar's nomination
articles.title: Uncertainty over Nigeria vote as court bars opposition leader
articles.summary: A Nigerian federal high court invalidated the nomination of Atiku Abubakar, the presidential candidate for the African Democratic Congress, on November 5, 2026. The ruling stems from internal leadership disputes within the party. While the party plans to appeal, the decision creates significant uncertainty for voters ahead of the January 16, 2027, general elections.
articles.description: The ADC, one of the main opposition parties trying to oust President Bola Tinubu, has been mired in lawsuits around its leadership, which have now ensnared its 2027 nominee

articles.headline: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
articles.title: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
articles.description: New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government, with rising cost of living a key concern for voters.

articles.headline: Meta introduces real-time voice mode for Muse AI agent
articles.title: Muse has a voice mode now
articles.summary: Meta has launched a new voice mode for its Muse artificial intelligence agent, featuring expressive avatars that animate during conversations. CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced the update, which is currently rolling out to users in the United States on the iOS app. The feature will soon expand to Meta’s AI glasses and the upcoming Muse Charm hardware device.
articles.description: Meta now lets you have voice conversations with your Muse AI agent in real time, CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced today. The feature has been rolled out to me, and I gave it a spin on the iOS app while writing this article. As you chat with your Muse agent, the avatar at the top of […]

articles.headline: Telangana government plans Kaleshwaram project barrage restoration for December
articles.title: CM directs officials to begin Kaleshwaram barrage restoration works in December
articles.summary: Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy ordered officials to begin restoration work on the Medigadda, Annaram, and Sundilla barrages in December 2026. The project, estimated at 4,193 crore rupees, must follow National Dam Safety Authority guidelines. Construction agencies will cover defect rectification costs, while the state government will fund additional works to ensure structural integrity and safety.
articles.description: Final approvals to be secured by month-end; ₹4,193 crore estimated for repairs and restoration

articles.headline: Revenue Minister orders damage assessment following Cyclone Murasu in Khammam
articles.title: Revenue Minister orders assessment of cyclone damage on war-footing
articles.summary: Revenue Minister Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy directed officials to assess damage to crops, roads, and infrastructure caused by Cyclone Murasu in the Khammam and Bhadradri Kothagudem districts. Collectors must submit detailed reports within three days. The Minister praised the State Disaster Response Force for their rescue operations, which were supported by recent government equipment investments.

articles.headline: GTB Developers to build World Trade Center township in Chengalpattu
articles.title: World Trade Center township on the anvil for Chengalpattu
articles.summary: GTB Developers has received a license from the World Trade Centers Association to build an IT-integrated township in Chengalpattu. The 7,000 crore rupee project will span 100 to 150 acres and include office, residential, and hospitality spaces. Development is expected to occur in phases over ten years, with land acquisition currently in the advanced stages.
articles.description: The project has an estimated value of ₹7,000 crore and will be developed in phases over approximately ten years

articles.headline: Senate Democrats express division over Chuck Schumer's leadership role
articles.title: Division among US Democrats over Schumer’s leadership role
articles.summary: Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer faces internal opposition as several incoming Democratic senators refuse to support his re-election. Critics cite concerns over his past political strategies and legislative effectiveness. While Schumer maintains confidence in securing a majority, progressive groups are calling for a contested leadership vote to define the party's future direction and agenda.
articles.description: Some Democratic senators – and the very voters that swept them into power – are demanding new leadership.

articles.headline: High Court to hear petition on corruption cases involving Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister
articles.title: HC to hear PIL on corruption cases involving Andhra CM Chandrababu Naidu on Nov. 10
articles.summary: The High Court will hear a public interest litigation on November 10 regarding corruption allegations against Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu. Petitioner K.B.G. Tilak seeks to transfer investigations to the Central Bureau of Investigation, fearing that the current government transition might impede existing probes into land acquisition, tender irregularities, and skill development centre projects.
articles.description: The PIL seeks transfer of the cases to the CBI; as the complainants are government officials, they have not come forward to challenge the closure reports for obvious reasons, argues the counsel for the petitioner

articles.headline: Four killed and two missing after SUV plunges into river in Uttarakhand
articles.title: Four killed, two missing as SUV plunges into river near Gangotri
articles.summary: Four people died and two remain missing after an SUV carrying seven passengers fell into the Bhagirathi river near Gangnani on November 5. The vehicle was travelling to the Gangotri temple when it lost control on the highway. Rescue teams recovered four bodies, while one injured passenger was hospitalised. Authorities are currently investigating the accident.
articles.description: According to police, the accident took place on the Gangotri National Highway when the vehicle reportedly went out of control and plunged into the river

articles.headline: Prime Minister Modi pledges support for Karnataka water conservation efforts
articles.title: PM assures Karnataka CM of full support in water conservation, management
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has promised Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar full central support for Karnataka’s water security and conservation initiatives. In a letter marking the state's formation day, Modi highlighted the severe drought affecting northern regions and urged the state to prioritise rainwater harvesting, waste management, and the rejuvenation of traditional water bodies for sustainability.

articles.headline: Sheikh Hasina confirms plan to return to Bangladesh from exile
articles.title: Hasina says she will return from exile in December ‘at any cost’
articles.summary: Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina stated she will return to Bangladesh from India in December despite facing a death sentence for crimes against humanity. Ousted in 2024, Hasina rejected the tribunal's verdict and alleged systemic suppression of her Awami League party. The current government, led by Tarique Rahman, has not commented on her potential arrival.
articles.description: Hasina's planned return comes as her party faces an uncertain future amid a sweeping crackdown. The party remains banned, with senior leaders arrested or driven into exile.

articles.headline: Indian Navy frigate INS Sahyadri arrives in Japan for Malabar 2026
articles.title: INS Sahyadri reaches Japan for multilateral naval exercise MALABAR 2026
articles.summary: The Indian Navy stealth frigate INS Sahyadri reached Yokosuka Naval Base on November 4 to join the multilateral Malabar 2026 exercise. The mission involves naval forces from India, Japan, the United States, and Australia. The exercise aims to improve interoperability and operational coordination through harbour planning and sea-based drills, reflecting India's commitment to regional maritime security.
articles.description: The harbour phase will involve professional interactions and coordinated planning, while the subsequent sea phase will see INS Sahyadri operate alongside participating naval units from the U.S., Australia and Japan

articles.headline: Mehli Mistry challenges Noel Tata's citizenship and tax residency status
articles.title: Mehli Mistry questions Noel Tata’s citizenship, tax residency status
articles.summary: Mehli Mistry has questioned Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata's Irish citizenship and UAE tax residency in a submission to the Charity Commissioner of Maharashtra. This follows Tata Trusts challenging Mistry's own status regarding his removal from three trusts. The dispute, which involves eligibility criteria for trusteeship, is scheduled for a hearing on December 3, 2026.
articles.description: Mehli Mistry said Noel Tata is an Irish citizen and a holder of a UAE Golden Visa

articles.headline: Bomb hoaxes: Messages reveal how threat was passed on by air traffic control
articles.title: Bomb hoaxes: Messages reveal how threat was passed on by air traffic control
articles.description: BBC Verify has been analysing messages after flights across Europe were targeted by fake bomb threats - the second such incident this week.

articles.headline: Supreme Court reviews High Powered Enquiry Committee findings on police brutality
articles.title: ‘Very few complaints’ received so far on police brutality during July 20 protests, says Supreme Court
articles.summary: The Supreme Court noted on November 5, 2026, that the High Powered Enquiry Committee received very few complaints regarding police brutality during the July 20 protests. The crackdown by Delhi Police on a Cockroach Janta Party demonstration caused numerous injuries, leading patients to seek treatment at Lady Hardinge Medical College and Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital. The apex court permitted petitioners to submit additional video evidence directly to the inquiry panel.
articles.description: The ATR said the lack of complaints from the protesters was despite repeated public notices that the grievances would be maintained confidentially, and would only be accessible to the Chairperson and HPEC members

articles.headline: OpenAI announces new community commitments for U.S. data-centre projects
articles.title: OpenAI formalises future U.S. data-centre safeguards; pledges union engagement, environmental disclosures
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced a National Community Compact for its future U.S. data-centre campuses, pledging to cover electricity and infrastructure costs while ensuring environmental transparency. The company will avoid non-disclosure agreements with officials and collaborate with unions. This policy follows rising public opposition to large-scale AI infrastructure projects across the United States and India.
articles.description: Amid growing U.S. opposition to data-centre expansion, company commits to bearing electricity and grid infrastructure costs, publishing water and power consumption, and working with unions on local hiring and training; proposes measures to make data-centre developers more accountable

articles.headline: Tokamak devices use magnetic fields to contain high-temperature plasma for nuclear fusion
articles.title: How do tokamaks work to make nuclear fusion possible?
articles.summary: Published on November 6, 2026, the report explains that tokamaks rely on toroidal vacuum chambers and magnetic coils to suspend superheated plasma without physical wall contact. While current nuclear energy primarily uses fission, fusion combines hydrogen isotopes like deuterium and tritium to produce helium and neutrons, requiring extreme temperatures that present significant physical containment challenges.
articles.description: A tokamak uses magnetic fields to confine superhot plasma to enable nuclear fusion; despite advances in research, engineering challenges remain, and no tokamak has generated net energy for commercial power

articles.headline: Claude AI introduces personal finance tool to connect with bank accounts
articles.title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched a new Personal Finance feature for its Claude chatbot, allowing US subscribers on specific plans to connect bank and card accounts via Plaid. The read-only tool helps users track spending categories, check balances, and review up to two years of transaction history. Anthropic stated that Claude cannot move or invest money, and the beta rollout follows similar features introduced by OpenAI for ChatGPT in May.
articles.description: Anthropic has a new pitch for managing your personal finances: let Claude do it instead, with a new Personal Finance feature that connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform. You can ask the chatbot "where did my money go this month," for example, and it'll create an overview […]

articles.headline: French unions stage mass protests and strikes over living costs
articles.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
articles.summary: More than 600,000 protesters demonstrated across France as five unions joined strikes demanding higher wages and better public services. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez deployed 70,000 police, reporting clashes and minor unrest in cities including Lyon, Rennes, and Bordeaux. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu announced a social conference with unions and employers to address purchasing power and wages amid ongoing economic pressures.
articles.description: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.

articles.headline: Iranians protest in Tehran following U.S. midterm election results
articles.title: Iranians burn giant poster of Trump and allies, demand revenge
articles.summary: Crowds in Tehran burned a poster of U.S. President Donald Trump and his allies on November 4, 2026, to demand revenge for the death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei. The protest followed the Republican Party's loss of control over the U.S. Congress. Iranian officials described the election outcome as a political defeat for the American administration.
articles.description: In the capital's central Enghelab square, crowds gathered to observe the burning of the poster featuring U.S. President Donald Trump, his Vice President J. D. Vance, special envoy Steve Witkoff, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu

articles.headline: India achieves 1.7% compressed biogas blending in first half of fiscal
articles.title: CBG blending at 1.7% in H1; pipeline connectivity key to achieving 3% target
articles.summary: India reached a 1.7% blending rate for compressed biogas with natural gas between April and September, according to the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board. To meet the 3% annual target, sales must increase significantly. The regulator highlighted that expanding pipeline connectivity to plants is essential to improve capacity utilisation and ensure consistent gas offtake.
articles.description: India has a target of blending 3% CBG into D-PNG and CNG by the end of current fiscal, 4% in 2027-28 and 5% in the subsequent year.

articles.headline: Hoax bomb threats target multiple European airlines and airports
articles.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
articles.summary: At least 21 aircraft and several airports across Europe were targeted by bomb threats in a malicious hoax described by UK Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander. Flights operated by carriers such as Aer Lingus, Finnair, and Ryanair were affected, with some escorted by fighter jets. Authorities confirmed that no explosives were found during security searches, and investigations into the source of the emails are ongoing.
articles.description: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

articles.headline: Repeat gold borrowing increases among low-risk customers despite repayment stress
articles.title: Repeat gold borrowing rises among low-risk customers, repayment stress persists: CIBIL
articles.summary: Over half of low-risk borrowers took additional gold loans within 12 months, according to TransUnion CIBIL. While overall portfolio quality improved, some segments show persistent repayment stress. Outstanding gold loan balances reached ₹22.5 lakh crore in August 2026. Experts suggest lenders must evaluate total financial obligations alongside pledged gold values to maintain responsible lending standards.
articles.description: Borrowers who had missed more than one payment in the preceding six months were three times as likely to become delinquent.

articles.headline: Russell Brand convicted of rape and sexual assault in London court
articles.title: Comedian Russell Brand found guilty by U.K. court of rape and sexual assaults
articles.summary: British comedian Russell Brand was found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault at London's Southwark Crown Court on November 5, 2026. The 51-year-old, who denied the allegations, was acquitted of two other rape charges and one attempted indecent assault. Prosecutors described the broadcaster as a ruthless sexual predator facing jail.
articles.description: Prosecutors had described the 51-year-old, who ⁠starred in the films “Get Him to the ‌Greek” and “Arthur”, as a ruthless, sexual predator

articles.headline: ISRO confirms NVS-03 navigation satellite is fully healthy after launch
articles.title: ISRO’s latest navigation satellite NVS-03 is fully healthy, says Chairman V. Narayanan
articles.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) confirmed its NVS-03 navigation satellite is functioning correctly following its October 30 launch. Chairman V. Narayanan stated the satellite is in a circular orbit and undergoing testing. He also highlighted ISRO's role in ensuring safety during the Axiom-4 mission and reaffirmed ongoing space technology collaboration between India and Russia.
articles.description: ISRO to conduct in-orbit testing for satellite payload as part of developing NavIC, an indigenous GPS alternative; ISRO chief recalls Indian scientists’ role in saving lives on the Axiom-4 mission; praises Russian support of India’s space programme

articles.headline: ONGC reports 57% profit growth despite lower production volumes
articles.title: ONGC Q2 net profit jumps 57% on higher crude, gas realisations
articles.summary: State-owned Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) posted a 57.3% year-on-year rise in net profit to ₹15,489 crore for the quarter ending September. The growth was driven by higher crude and gas prices. However, crude oil and natural gas production declined due to reservoir complexities and operational challenges, according to the company's official statement.
articles.description: Along with the results, the company declared an interim dividend of ₹8 per equity share.

articles.headline: Jordanian officer killed in stabbing attack in Amman
articles.title: Jordanian officer killed in stabbing attack in Amman
articles.description: A Jordanian security officer has been killed and another one wounded near the Sri Lankan embassy in Amman.

articles.headline: India-Sri Lanka ODI series opener moved to Visakhapatnam
articles.title: India-Sri Lanka ODI moved from Delhi to Visakhapatnam
articles.summary: The Board of Control for Cricket in India announced that the first ODI between India and Sri Lanka on December 13, 2026, has been relocated from Delhi to Visakhapatnam. The Delhi and District Cricket Association requested the change due to ongoing stadium renovations at the Arun Jaitley Stadium and concerns regarding potential weather disruptions in the capital.
articles.description: If not for the renovation of the outfield at the Arun Jaitley Stadium, a major issue with hosting the game in the national capital would have been the poor air quality in the month of December

articles.headline: LIC net profit rises 20% on strong premium income growth
articles.title: LIC Q2 profit rises 20% to ₹12,115 crore as VNB margin and net premium expands
articles.summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) reported a 20% year-on-year profit increase to ₹12,115 crore for the quarter ended September. Growth was supported by a 16.2% rise in net premium income and expanded margins. The insurer plans to focus on pure-term protection and non-participating savings products to maintain momentum in its expanding bancassurance network.
articles.description: LIC expects further improvement in VNB margins, supported by a favourable product mix and growth in high-margin segments, particularly non-participating (non-par) savings and term assurance.

articles.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber model with enhanced security safeguards
articles.title: OpenAI says its new cybersecurity model is better at not hacking other companies
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model designed to identify vulnerabilities while reducing unauthorized hacking risks. Testing shows the model remains within bounds over 99% of the time, outperforming its predecessor. Classified as critical, the tool is currently available to select Daybreak Red program members for authorized defensive work on real-world critical systems.
articles.description: OpenAI is launching GPT-6 Cyber, the latest version of its cybersecurity AI model, which it says is better at finding vulnerabilities and less likely to go rogue and hack other platforms in the process. OpenAI says that during testing, GPT-6 Cyber went out of bounds less than 1 percent of the time, down from around […]

articles.headline: Mahindra and Mahindra reports 25 percent profit growth for second quarter
articles.title: M&M Q2 PAT rises 25% to ₹4,588 crore on strong auto, finance performance
articles.summary: Mahindra and Mahindra reported a 25 percent year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax to 4,588 crore rupees for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Revenue rose 25 percent to 57,515 crore rupees. Executives attributed the performance to operational discipline and strong demand in the automobile sector, despite a marginal decline in the farm business.
articles.description: Auto continued to grow on the back of strong consumer demand, while Farm experienced a marginal decline on account of the festive season shift.

articles.headline: Bishara: US election deals a blow to warmongers
articles.title: Bishara: US election deals a blow to warmongers
articles.description: Al Jazeera's senior political analyst Marwan Bishara says the US election is a setback for warmongers.

articles.headline: Gaza holds final of tournament honouring more than 1,000 slain athletes
articles.title: Gaza holds final of tournament honouring more than 1,000 slain athletes
articles.description: The final of Gaza’s ‘Thousand Martyrs’ Cup marks the return of organised football after nearly three years of war.

articles.headline: Multiple flights across Europe diverted following series of bomb threats
articles.title: Multiple flights in Europe diverted because of bomb threats
articles.summary: Several flights across Europe were diverted for emergency landings on November 5, 2026, due to bomb threats. Ryanair flights bound for Bulgaria and an Aer Lingus flight diverted to a French military base were among those affected. Authorities confirmed passengers are safe, while security teams continue to investigate the incidents amid rising regional geopolitical tensions.
articles.description: Several flights across Europe received hoax bomb threats this week that prompted searches, diversions and, in one case, an escort by the Italian air force until landing, officials said

articles.headline: French workers strike nationwide to demand higher wages and tax reform
articles.title: France workers strike, march for 'dignified wage'
articles.summary: Hundreds of thousands of workers marched across France on November 5, 2026, to protest the rising cost of living and demand wage increases. The CGT union reported participation in 73 cities, while the Education Ministry noted 16 percent of teachers joined the strike. Authorities deployed 70,000 security personnel to manage the largely peaceful demonstrations.
articles.description: The demonstrations come as the eurozone's second largest economy battles to redress its finances, six months ahead of elections to replace centrist President Emmanuel Macron

articles.headline: Kozo Tashima announces bid for FIFA presidency against Gianni Infantino
articles.title: Top Japan FA official to stand against Infantino for FIFA presidency
articles.summary: Kozo Tashima, honorary president of the Japan Football Association, announced his candidacy for the FIFA presidential election scheduled for March. Tashima, a former FIFA Council member, aims to promote ethical standards in global football. He joins former player Ramon Vega in challenging incumbent Gianni Infantino, who remains the favorite to secure a fourth term.
articles.description: Kozo Tashima second person to declare he will challenge Infantino, after former Spurs defender Ramon Vega.

articles.headline: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault charges
articles.title: Russell Brand is being investigated over two new rape complaints, police say
articles.summary: Disgraced British comedian Russell Brand was found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault by a jury at Southwark Crown Court following a three-week trial. Detective Superintendent Andy Furphy from the Metropolitan Police stated that officers investigated multiple historical allegations dating back years, resulting in a conviction that may encourage other victims to come forward.
articles.description: Det Supt Andy Furphy said he hoped other potential victims would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts.

articles.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo announces retirement from international football
articles.title: Ronaldo in records: International milestones from the football icon
articles.summary: Portuguese football legend Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international competition after a 23-year career spanning six World Cups and six European Championships. The 41-year-old holds records for 234 appearances and 146 goals for Portugal, captaining his country to titles at Euro 2016 and the Nations League. His departure follows a recent dispute with coach Jorge Jesus over playing time.
articles.description: Ronaldo, 41, ended an illustrious 23-year career that spanned six World Cups and six European Championships.

articles.headline: Guinea-Bissau halts controversial hepatitis B vaccine trial for infants
articles.title: Why Guinea-Bissau halted a controversial hepatitis vaccine trial for babies
articles.summary: Guinea-Bissau has suspended a United States-funded hepatitis B vaccine trial involving 14,000 infants after failing to secure government approval. Critics, including the World Health Organization, condemned the study as unethical for withholding vaccines from some babies. Researchers from the Bandim Health Project argued the study provided a unique opportunity to assess vaccination timing.
articles.description: Experts have said the US-funded trial would deny critical vaccines to thousands of infants.

articles.headline: SoundCloud integrates ElevenLabs to allow direct AI music uploads
articles.title: You can post AI music straight to SoundCloud from ElevenLabs
articles.summary: SoundCloud has partnered with the generative AI platform ElevenLabs, enabling users to publish AI-created music directly to the streaming service. Tracks uploaded through this integration will be labeled to indicate their AI origins. Additionally, SoundCloud Artist Pro subscribers are eligible for a three-month free trial of ElevenMusic Pro as part of the new collaboration.
articles.description: After partnering with Moises earlier this year, SoundCloud is now adding integration with another AI music platform, ElevenLabs. Now, rather than having to export and download your outputs from ElevenLabs and then upload them to SoundCloud, you can publish them directly. As part of the partnership, SoundCloud Artist Pro subscribers are also getting three months […]

articles.headline: Adam Hamawy becomes New Jersey’s first Muslim US congressman
articles.title: ‘Healthcare not bombs’: How Gaza shaped Adam Hamawy’s path to US Congress
articles.summary: Adam Hamawy, a 56-year-old Egyptian-American reconstructive surgeon and US Army veteran, won his election for New Jersey’s 12th Congressional District on Tuesday. Hamawy, who campaigned on a healthcare-focused platform, previously served as a combat surgeon in Iraq. He entered politics following humanitarian missions to Gaza, where he witnessed the impact of the ongoing conflict firsthand.
articles.description: Former army surgeon and Gaza volunteer Hamawy is the first Muslim American elected to the US Congress from New Jersey.

articles.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football after 23 years
articles.title: A bitter end for Ronaldo - the icon who transformed Portugal
articles.summary: Portugal legend Cristiano Ronaldo has retired from international football at age 41 following a 23-year career. His departure follows a 30-day suspension for leaving a training camp without permission. Ronaldo, who scored 146 goals in 234 appearances, leaves behind a legacy of transforming the national team, including leading Portugal to their first European Championship title in 2016.
articles.description: As Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football, Guillem Balague looks at why and what is next for the Portugal legend.

articles.headline: Rubbish piles up in besieged Yemeni city of Taiz
articles.title: Burning rubbish chokes besieged Yemeni city of Taiz
articles.summary: Residents of Taiz, Yemen, are facing a severe waste crisis as sanitation trucks cannot reach landfills due to a month-long Houthi siege and escalating conflict. With fuel shortages and security threats preventing collection, residents have begun burning waste, creating toxic fumes. The United Nations warns that the city’s humanitarian situation is rapidly deteriorating amid the blockade.
articles.description: Taiz residents face health risks as waste accumulates amid sniper fire, forcing people to burn it in the streets.

articles.headline: Police bodycam captures moments before deadly Russian strike in Ukraine
articles.title: Police bodycam captures moments before deadly Russian strike in Ukraine
articles.description: Bodycam footage released by Ukraine’s National Police shows people rushing into an underground shelter.

articles.headline: Voyager 1 spacecraft approaches major distance milestone
articles.title: Postcards from Earth
articles.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 probe is nearing a milestone of being one light-day away from Earth on November 18. Launched in 1977, the spacecraft carries a golden record containing human sounds and images intended for potential interstellar discovery. The mission, which passed Neptune in 1990, continues to provide a humbling perspective on our planet's place.
articles.description: Voyager I’s forty-nine-year journey into the void

articles.headline: BJP faces political risks from partisan electoral map redrawing
articles.title: What the BJP should learn from Trump’s redistricting failure
articles.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party should consider the Republican Party's recent failures in the United States when pursuing electoral boundary changes. Despite Republican efforts to flip seats through gerrymandering, the party suffered significant losses. Recent by-election results in Bihar suggest that constituency mapping cannot guarantee success if a party loses support from its traditional voter base.
articles.description: Gerrymandering assumes that voting preferences remain unchanged between election cycles; but when the traditional supporters of a party turn against it, constituency maps matter little.

articles.headline: Amit Shah criticizes Rahul Gandhi at Karnal rally over parliamentary disruptions
articles.title: Rahul Gandhi has turned boycotting Parliament into a Congress hallmark, says Amit Shah
articles.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah accused Rahul Gandhi of fostering a culture of parliamentary disruption and boycotts within the Congress party during a rally in Karnal. Leading the Bharatiya Janata Party march, Mr. Shah also alleged that the opposition leader promotes anarchy and challenged him regarding his foreign visits. The campaign follows recent political tensions between the ruling party and the opposition INDIA bloc over electoral rolls.
articles.description: The BJP’s ‘Loktantra bachao, arajakta hatao’ nationwide campaign began on October 22, against the backdrop of Opposition parties protesting over allegations of electoral irregularities and the functioning of democratic institutions

articles.headline: Democrats take control of United States Senate and House in midterm elections
articles.title: How America voted in maps and charts
articles.summary: The Democratic Party secured control of both the United States Senate and the House of Representatives during the midterm elections, according to projections by CBS News on November 4, 2026. Democrats achieved significant victories in states including South Carolina, Texas, and Iowa. Exit polling indicated that voters viewed the economy as the primary concern, with a majority expressing dissatisfaction with Donald Trump's economic policies.
articles.description: See the maps and charts that show how America voted in the US midterm elections.

articles.headline: New Yorkers rally against gun violence after Ghanaian teen’s killing
articles.title: New Yorkers rally against gun violence after Ghanaian teen’s killing
articles.description: New Yorkers marched to demand justice for Ghanaian boy Javits Frimpong, who was shot and killed in the Bronx last month.

articles.headline: Jordanian security officer killed in stabbing attack in Amman
articles.title: Security ⁠officer killed in stabbing attack in Jordan’s capital
articles.summary: A Jordanian security officer, Corporal Jawad Ali Khalaf al-Salaita, was killed in a stabbing attack outside the Sri Lankan embassy in Amman on Thursday. Authorities described the incident as a terrorist act. The assailant, who had prior terrorism convictions, was wounded by a second officer during the struggle and remains in critical condition at a local hospital.
articles.description: Assailant stabbed a corporal outside the Sri Lankan embassy in Amman, killing him and injuring another officer.

articles.headline: Karnataka government increases bus fares across four state-run transport corporations
articles.title: Bus travel gets costlier in Karnataka; fares hiked by 23% to 35%
articles.summary: The Karnataka government revised bus fares upward by 23 percent to 35 percent across four state transport corporations, effective midnight on November 4, 2026. Transport Minister Byrathi Suresh stated that the adjustments, which affect ordinary, express, and airport services, were necessary due to rising diesel expenses and operational losses, falling below recommendations from the Public Transport Fare Regulatory Committee.
articles.description: According to the revised fare structure, BMTC fares have increased by ₹4 to ₹12, depending on the distance travelled. For KSRTC, NWKRTC and KKRTC services, the increase ranges from ₹9 to ₹18, depending on the stages of travel and the type of service.

articles.headline: Asaduddin Owaisi criticises electoral revision process after no illegal immigrants found
articles.title: With no illegal immigrants found on draft electoral rolls, SIR greatly inconvenienced people: Owaisi
articles.summary: Hyderabad parliamentarian Asaduddin Owaisi stated that the Special Intensive Revision process caused unnecessary hardship for poor daily wage earners despite election officials finding zero foreign nationals on the draft rolls. Speaking on November 4, 2026, the AIMIM president also condemned federal efforts to remove the historic Qadeemic Masjid inside New Delhi's Krishi Bhavan complex.
articles.description: Qadeemi Masjid was there before Delhi became the national capital, says AIMIM president

articles.headline: Indonesian authorities deploy security for former President Widodo's court appearance
articles.title: Thousands of troops secure Indonesia trial as tensions run high over wiretap scandal
articles.summary: Thousands of police and military personnel secured a Jakarta court on November 5 for former President Joko Widodo's defamation trial. The hearing occurs amid high tensions following a wiretapping scandal involving senior generals. While the trial concerns diploma allegations, authorities remain on alert due to the broader political instability surrounding the unauthorized surveillance of officials.
articles.description: Three senior generals have already been detained in the wiretapping scandal, including Gen. Listyo Sigit Prabowo, who had been named chief of staff to President Prabowo Subianto last month

articles.headline: Ghana faces housing affordability crisis despite increased investment
articles.title: Why more investment is not making housing affordable in Ghana
articles.summary: Ghana requires 1.8 million new homes, yet most citizens cannot afford market-rate housing. While the government has introduced mortgage funds and interest rate reductions, experts argue that high construction costs, expensive land, and reliance on imported materials remain significant barriers. Developers and policymakers are now exploring ways to improve local manufacturing and financing accessibility.
articles.description: High costs, limited financing and rising demand keep homes out of reach.

articles.headline: Four former tennis stars elected to AITA governing body
articles.title: Bhupathi, Sania among four Sportspersons of Merit elected to AITA governing body
articles.summary: Mahesh Bhupathi and Sania Mirza are among four former players elected as Sportspersons of Outstanding Merit to the All India Tennis Association governing body. Ashutosh Singh and Shalini Thakur Chawla also secured seats. This initiative follows the National Sports Governance Act, aiming to increase the influence of accomplished athletes in national sports federation administration.
articles.description: Bhupathi secured the highest number of votes with 19, followed by Mirza with 18

articles.headline: Democrats secure control of US Congress in midterm elections
articles.title: Visualising how the US midterms turned the map blue
articles.summary: Democrats have won majorities in both the House of Representatives and the Senate following the November 3 midterm elections. With at least 240 House seats and 54 Senate seats secured, the party flipped numerous Republican-held districts. The new Congress will take office on January 3, 2027, granting Democrats oversight powers despite President Trump's remaining veto authority.
articles.description: Who voted, which seats flipped and who made history? A look at the numbers behind the 2026 US midterm elections.

articles.headline: Serbian police officers arrested for using excessive force against protesters
articles.title: Serbian officers arrested for using ‘excessive force’ against protesters
articles.summary: Serbian authorities arrested nine active police officers and one former officer on Wednesday for allegedly torturing protesters in Belgrade in August 2025. The suspects, reportedly from an elite unit, are accused of using threats and violence to intimidate individuals. The arrests follow widespread unrest sparked by a deadly railway station collapse in November 2024 and subsequent elections.
articles.description: Ten suspects are accused of abusing and torturing several people in the garage of a government compound in Belgrade.

articles.headline: Harry Kane signs contract extension with Bayern Munich until 2029
articles.title: England’s Harry Kane extends Bayern Munich contract until 2029
articles.summary: England captain Harry Kane has extended his contract with Bayern Munich until June 2029. The 33-year-old striker, who recently won the Ballon d'Or, joined the German club in 2023. Having secured multiple domestic titles, Kane expressed his commitment to the team and manager Vincent Kompany, dismissing speculation regarding a potential return to the English Premier League.
articles.description: 'I love the club, the fans and the city,' says the Ballon d'Or ‌winner after extending his stay with German champions.

articles.headline: Survey reveals specific migration corridors from northeastern states to southern India
articles.title: Some northeast districts have their own migration corridors for jobs in southern India, reveals survey
articles.summary: A survey conducted by Seven Sisters Development Assistance across 14 administrative blocks in Assam, Meghalaya, and Tripura revealed distinct migration corridors for employment in southern India. Published on November 5, 2026, the study covered 693 households, noting that 88 percent of individuals migrated due to local job shortages. Karnataka emerged as the top destination, attracting 22.7 percent of the outflow. Researchers found that median monthly earnings stood at 15,000 rupees, with personal networks rather than formal institutions driving the relocations.
articles.description: The study by a Guwahati-based non-profit development organisation says 91% of the respondents across three States cited a “push” factor, such as shortage of land for farming or the need to repay loans, behind migration

articles.headline: Israeli court extends detention of journalist Abed Abou Shhadeh
articles.title: Israel extends detention of Palestinian journalist Abed Abou Shhadeh
articles.summary: The Tel Aviv Magistrate’s Court ruled that Palestinian journalist Abed Abou Shhadeh will remain in custody until November 8. Arrested at his home in Jaffa, he faces allegations of contact with a foreign agent. His legal team, Adalah, denies the claims, arguing the detention is a politically motivated campaign to silence Palestinian activists and journalists.
articles.description: Rights group says the journalist's arrest over an interview with Azmi Bishara is an attempt to silence Palestinians.

articles.headline: Multiple European flights diverted following series of bomb threats
articles.title: New bomb threats bring more disruption to flights across Europe
articles.summary: Approximately 10 flights across Europe were targeted by bomb threats on Thursday, forcing emergency landings and diversions. An Aer Lingus flight from Dublin to Rome was escorted to France by military aircraft. Other incidents involved planes landing in Bulgaria, Belgium, and Austria. Authorities reported no suspicious items were found, and many alerts were considered hoaxes.
articles.description: Flights make emergency landings in France, Italy and Bulgaria days after bomb threats disrupted air traffic.

articles.headline: Harry Kane signs contract extension with Bayern Munich until 2029
articles.title: Harry Kane signs Bayern Munich contract extension until 2029
articles.summary: England captain Harry Kane has extended his contract with Bayern Munich through June 30, 2029. The 33-year-old striker, who recently won the Ballon d'Or, joined the German club in 2023. Since his arrival, he has secured multiple domestic titles and finished as the Bundesliga's top scorer in each season, cementing his role as a key player.
articles.description: The 33-year-old striker has scored 156 goals in 161 appearances in all competitions for Bayern and capped his prolific spell ‌in Munich by winning the Ballon d'Or recently

articles.headline: NDA sweeps Urban Local Body elections in Andhra Pradesh
articles.title: What NDA’s clean sweep in local body polls means for Andhra Pradesh politics
articles.summary: The National Democratic Alliance comprising the Telugu Desam Party, Jana Sena Party, and Bharatiya Janata Party has swept the Urban Local Body elections in Andhra Pradesh. The polls concluded following sporadic violence during nominations and voting. Minister Nara Lokesh noted that the outcome matched the landslide victory achieved by the alliance during the 2024 Andhra Pradesh Assembly polls.
articles.description: NDA’s thumping success in the local body elections is on the expected line, say political analysts, adding that though results show no hint of anti-incumbency, the alliance partners need to focus on ironing out the rifts

articles.headline: Ramayana film adaptation premieres worldwide with high production costs and mixed reviews
articles.title: India's costliest film retells a beloved Hindu epic - but divides critics
articles.summary: Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the high-budget film Ramayana: Rise of a Legend has opened globally following a massive 500 million dollar production. The movie features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram and Yash as Ravana, incorporating visual effects from DNEG and musical scores by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. Critics offered contrasting opinions, with NDTV rating it three out of five stars while The Guardian awarded four stars, praising its spectacular scale and ambitious narrative scope.
articles.description: Easily the most anticipated Bollywood film of the year, Ramayana: Rise of a Legend is the first of two parts.

articles.headline: Coal pile collapse kills three women and injures three in Jharkhand
articles.title: Three killed, 3 injured as coal pile collapses in Jharkhand’s Kathara colliery
articles.summary: Three women died and three others sustained injuries after a heap of coal collapsed at Central Coalfield Limited's Kathara colliery located in the Bokaro district of Jharkhand. According to Bokaro Deputy Commissioner Ajay Nath Jha, the tragic accident occurred around 5 a.m. when the victims were collecting coal from the site. A Central Coalfield Limited official stated that the incident involved coal theft.
articles.description: The Central Coalfield Limited official said it was a case of coal theft

articles.headline: Kerala High Court grants anticipatory bail to judge in car crash probe
articles.title: Cheranalloor crash: Kerala HC grants anticipatory bail to judge whose minor son allegedly drove luxury car
articles.summary: The Kerala High Court granted anticipatory bail to an Additional Judge whose minor son allegedly drove his luxury car into a scooter, causing the death of a 55-year-old man in Kochi on October 25. Justice Kauser Edappagath noted that the judicial officer fully cooperated with a six-hour police interrogation and home search. The judge's counsel stated that the boy took the vehicle without his father's knowledge.
articles.description: Justice Kauser Edappagath observes that the Additional Judge, who was interrogated by the police for six hours, has all along cooperated with the probe

articles.headline: Victor Wembanyama scores 52 points to lead Spurs past Mavericks
articles.title: Wembanyama pours in career-high 52 points as Spurs edge Mavericks 112-111
articles.summary: Victor Wembanyama recorded a career-high 52 points, 24 rebounds, and eight blocked shots, securing the winning free throw with 24.2 seconds remaining to lift the San Antonio Spurs to a 112-111 victory over the Dallas Mavericks on Wednesday. Kyrie Irving missed a final shot for Dallas, which suffered its second consecutive defeat despite Irving leading his team with 29 points in the tightly contested matchup.
articles.description: Victor Wembanyama had 24 rebounds and 52 points as the San Antonio Spurs recorded their sixth straight win in the NBA.

articles.headline: Christian delegation meets RSS leader over mob attacks in West Bengal
articles.title: Christian representatives meet West Bengal RSS leader over mob attacks on congregations and churches
articles.summary: A delegation from the Bangiya Christiya Pariseba met with Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh leader Jishnu Saha to address recent mob violence against churches and pastors in West Bengal. While the forum reported 60 hate crimes since May, the RSS leader called for investigations into both the attacks and allegations of forced religious conversions by Christian groups.
articles.description: Senior RSS functionary from West Bengal Jishnu Basu, the Saha Khetra Prachar Pramukh of South Bengal, said that dialogue will continue with the representatives of Christian organisations but there are genuine concerns about forced conversion

articles.headline: Jaishankar urges Commonwealth members to de-risk and diversify supply chains
articles.title: Jaishankar urges Commonwealth partners to 'de-risk and diversify'
articles.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar attended the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in St. John's on November 3, 2026. Speaking at a business leaders meeting, he emphasized enhancing local distribution, connectivity corridors, and digital public infrastructure to drive growth. He also met with United Kingdom Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese to discuss economic partnerships and trade agreements.
articles.description: S. Jaishankar said Commonwealth partners need to make more efforts to enhance local distribution, adding that more connectivity corridors are good for business

articles.headline: Amish Shah wins Arizona congressional race to become sixth Indian-American representative
articles.title: Amish Shah claims victory in Arizona, sixth Indian-American in U.S. House
articles.summary: Democratic physician Amish Shah won the election on November 4, 2026, for the United States House of Representatives in Arizona's First Congressional District. Defeating Republican Jay Feely with 52.49 percent of the vote, Dr. Shah made history as the first Indian-American to represent Arizona in Congress while successfully flipping a previously Republican-held seat.
articles.description: Amish Shah made history as he became the first Indian-American to represent Arizona in Congress. By defeating Feely, Mr. Shah flipped a Republican-held seat

articles.headline: Supreme Court directs Azam Khan to seek relief from Allahabad High Court
articles.title: Supreme Court asks Allahabad HC to give Azam Khan priority hearing
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of India advised senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan to approach the Allahabad High Court regarding his recent arrest by the Directorate of Enforcement. The apex court requested a priority hearing on November 16. Khan, who faces numerous criminal cases, alleges political motivation behind his ongoing legal challenges in Uttar Pradesh.
articles.description: The Supreme Court has asked the High Court to hear the case on November 16; Azam Khan alleges “series of politically motivated cases”

articles.headline: Rajeev Chandrasekhar tells Rahul Gandhi to go to Bangladesh over alleged anarchy
articles.title: Keralam BJP chief Rajeev Chandrasekhar tells Rahul Gandhi to ‘go to Bangladesh’, accuses him of ‘creating anarchy’
articles.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party Keralam president Rajeev Chandrasekhar told Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on November 5, 2026, to relocate to Bangladesh and accused him of attempting to create anarchy in India. Chandrasekhar asserted that Indian democracy is protected by citizens and alleged that Gandhi is trying to divert public attention amid protests over voter roll revisions and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
articles.description: In a Facebook post, Rajeev Chandrasekhar says Rahul Gandhi ‘can take along Jamaat-e-Islami, which supports him, and pursue politics there’

articles.headline: South Korea to expand naval anti-piracy operations near Hormuz Strait
articles.title: South Korea plans to expand anti-piracy operations closer to Hormuz Strait
articles.summary: South Korea plans to extend its Cheonghae naval unit's operational area toward the Strait of Hormuz to protect economic interests. The Ministry of National Defense stated the mission remains noncombat and independent of allied forces. Opposition lawmakers expressed concerns that the expansion could draw the nation into the ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran.
articles.description: Seoul proposes extending its Cheonghae unit’s patrols to waters near Oman’s Duqm amid US pressure over Iran war.

articles.headline: Delhi Police registers FIR over child abuse material on Meta platforms
articles.title: Delhi Police registers FIR over alleged circulation of child sexual abuse material on Meta platforms
articles.summary: The Delhi Police Special Cell registered an FIR on October 8 regarding the circulation of suspected child sexual abuse material on Facebook and Instagram. Officials are investigating approximately 10 flagged links under the Information Technology Act. The probe follows a complaint regarding the availability of such content on platforms operated by Meta India.
articles.description: Approximately 10 links were flagged in a complaint alleging the circulation of such material, following which the police initiated an investigation to verify the allegations, says an official

articles.headline: Germany’s Merz expects Trump to keep ignoring Congress
articles.title: Germany’s Merz expects Trump to keep ignoring Congress
articles.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz expects US President Donald Trump to keep bypassing Congress despite midterm losses.

articles.headline: Enforcement Directorate attaches assets linked to Reliance Anil Ambani Group
articles.title: ED action in Reliance Anil Ambani Group cases | Explained
articles.summary: The Enforcement Directorate has cumulatively seized or attached assets worth approximately 23,100 crore rupees in cases involving the Reliance Anil Ambani Group. On November 3, the agency attached an additional 510.17 crore rupees in assets related to alleged bank fraud cases involving Reliance Communications, Reliance Home Finance, and Reliance Commercial Finance under anti-money laundering laws.
articles.description: On November 3, the ED said it had attached assets worth ₹510.17 crore linked to the group in connection with alleged bank fraud cases against Reliance Communications Limited, Reliance Home Finance Limited and Reliance Commercial Finance Limited

articles.headline: Fenerbahce defeats Liverpool as Como records historic Champions League victory
articles.title: Champions League: Liverpool suffer 3-2 loss at Fenerbahce, Como thump Lens
articles.summary: Fenerbahce secured a 3-2 victory over Liverpool in the Champions League following Vedat Muriqi’s late winner. Meanwhile, Italian club Como achieved a historic 9-1 win against Lens, matching the competition's record for the largest victory margin. Elsewhere, Real Madrid defeated AEK Athens 3-2, while Manchester City and Arsenal also secured wins in their respective matches.
articles.description: Como equal Champions League record with stunning 9-1 win at Lens as Haaland rescues Manchester City at Leipzig.

articles.headline: Cyclone Murasu brings heavy overnight rainfall to Telangana districts
articles.title: Cyclone Murasu impact on Telangana | Extremely heavy rains lash Bhadradri on November 4
articles.summary: Mandal areas in Khammam and Bhadradri Kothagudem districts recorded extremely heavy rainfall between 204 mm and 235 mm overnight due to cyclone Murasu, according to a report issued on November 4, 2026, by the Telangana Development Planning Society. The India Meteorological Department placed Bhadradri Kothagudem under an orange alert for heavy rain, while continuing showers caused accumulation reaching 88 mm in local mandals.

articles.headline: New Zealand general election shows parties neck and neck in polls
articles.title: New Zealand braces for knife-edge election: What you need to know
articles.summary: New Zealand is preparing for a general election on November 7, 2026, with polls showing Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's National Party and the opposition Labour Party in a tight race. Operating under a mixed-member proportional system, neither major party is projected to win an outright majority, meaning smaller parties will likely determine the formation of the next coalition government.
articles.description: Smaller parties hold the key, with major contenders expected to fall short of the majority needed to govern alone.

articles.headline: Jailed Indian scholar Sharjeel Imam triggers debate over minority representation and democracy
articles.title: Has India’s democracy failed its Muslims? Jailed scholar triggers debate
articles.summary: Sharjeel Imam, a 38-year-old Indian scholar imprisoned since January 2020, has sparked a national debate regarding the political representation of Muslims in India. In an interview from New Delhi prison with The Quint on September 29, Imam criticized the constitution and secular framework, drawing mixed reactions from legal scholars and academics regarding minority rights and systemic democracy.
articles.description: Sharjeel Imam questioned foundational ideas of India's nationalism in interview with The Quint, inspiring heated debate.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu approaches Supreme Court over unpaid Cauvery river water releases
articles.title: Tamil Nadu seeks urgent oral mentioning in Supreme Court over Cauvery water issue
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu government made an urgent oral mentioning before the Supreme Court of India on November 5, 2026, accusing Karnataka of withholding Cauvery river water since October 23. Counsel B. Karunakaran told a Bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant that four lakh hectares of crops are at risk because Karnataka failed to release 3,000 cusecs daily as ordered.
articles.description: The court agreed to list the plea early

articles.headline: Israeli opposition criticises Benjamin Netanyahu after Democrats win US Congress
articles.title: Israel’s opposition slams ‘toxic Netanyahu’ after Democrats win US Congress
articles.summary: Israeli opposition politicians criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday following Democratic majorities in the United States Congress. Yair Lapid and other leaders argued that Netanyahu has eroded bipartisan support and endangered security. Meanwhile, opposition figures pledged to restore relations with Washington, as Netanyahu did not immediately respond to the criticism regarding his governance and foreign policy stance.
articles.description: Netanyahu's rivals say US midterm results show Israel 'cannot afford' to have the prime minister remain in office.

articles.headline: AERB chairperson assures safety standards amid private nuclear sector entry
articles.title: Private sector participation in nuclear energy: No compromise on safety aspects, says AERB Chairperson
articles.summary: Atomic Energy Regulatory Board Chairperson A.K. Balasubrahmanian stated on November 5, 2026, that safety standards will not be compromised as private players enter India's nuclear energy sector. Speaking at a symposium organised by the Atomic Energy Retirees' Association, he explained that the sector is opening up to meet national power requirements while the board maintains strict regulatory enforcement.
articles.description: The AERB chairperson’s remarks gain significance in the context of SHANTI Act and the Union government’s policy decision to welcome private players

articles.headline: BAMUL increases prices of ghee, butter and paneer in Karnataka
